instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f11_chirp'>Like we do in this class, many people across the globe speak English. Firstly, this is because of the colonisation of many countries by the British Empire and secondly due to increasing globalisation. In fact, English is spoken by 1.5 billion people today an is even an official language in sixty-seven countries. Also, have you ever noticed how English words don't always sound the same? This is because of dialects, which are regional versions of a language and can vary in terms of pronunciation, spelling, and even have different meanings for some words.</voice>
